data.commit_message:
Add verified benchmark discovery registry and AA field inventory

Register 73 isolated benchmark identities with publication recipes, scoring semantics and source evidence. Preserve 646 raw AA model rows, keep Coding Agent Index v1.4/v1.5 separate, and validate registry provenance during dataset builds.

Co-Authored-By: Codex GPT-6 Astra (Sandy rebuild) <noreply@openai.com>
